verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability for a compliance and registered-agent SaaS like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the content host is walled behind a Cloudflare challenge, with no evidence of any in-product AI assistant or task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
